players.product: obesity and metabolic-disease therapeutics; multispecific protein therapeutics designed with The Generate Platform

quarterly_data.quarter: Zealand Pharma press release: Zealand Pharma announces initiation of the registrational (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Zealand and partner Roche started the global registrational Phase 3a ZUPREME program for once-weekly petrelintide: ZUPREME-3 (about 3,900 participants, without type 2 diabetes), ZUPREME-4 (about 600, with type 2 diabetes) and ZUPREME-5 (about 2,500, with cardiovascular disease), about 7,000 in total, primary endpoint body-weight change at week 64; a Phase 2 trial of petrelintide with Roche's enicepatide (CT-388) is planned to start in the second half of 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: about 7,000 participants across three Phase 3 trials
